payload.recallText: Hi I grew up in providence rhode island and for my entire childhood me and my family were never further away than 20 miles from the city center and everyone around us shared the same values were all catholic irish just like the Kennedys we were all a family anything that happened to us happened to them and anything that happened to them happened to us that meant that any tragedy was doubled  we were at our grandmas house and after a thanksgiving dinner there was a fight and on our way back home in our dads car dad was driving i was in the back and then there was someone talking on the radio about jfk's assassination and i started crying at which point my sister said dad micayla's crying at which point my dad turned around and said you never be ashamed to cry for that man my parents were from newport and got married there at the same church as jack jackies saint mary my aunts in the 70s took me to the bachfront and they ad the same conversations over and over again one afternoon they were busy and noone was paying attention to me and my cousing in the water we were 9 years old and we found something it was a little half inflated boat but we got in trpuble at which point a power boat comes saves us takes us to the shore we used to have chicken fights the three of us
